description: This file defines a decorator class for the BuzzLikeOnShare entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to associate an employee and a share with a BuzzLikeOnShare instance, and to retrieve formatted date and time information related to when a like was made.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the BuzzLikeOnShare entity, providing methods to modify and retrieve information about likes on shares in the Buzz module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a BuzzLikeOnShare entity.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Returns the internal BuzzLikeOnShare entity instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the BuzzLikeOnShare based on employee number.

methods.name: setShareByShareId
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare with the BuzzLikeOnShare based on share ID.

methods.name: getLikedAtDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the share was liked, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLikedAtTime
methods.description: Retrieves the time when the share was liked, formatted as a string.
